from pathlib import Path
program_dir=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792545201/attempts/077c639e3ede471faa305f8b7291dc1f/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
path=program_dir/'task-a18cae23.py'
source='''def transform(grid):
    anchors = [(r, row[0]) for r, row in enumerate(grid) if any(v != 0 for v in row)]
    period = len(anchors)
    phase_color = {r % period: color for r, color in anchors}
    return [[phase_color[r % period]] * len(grid[0]) for r in range(len(grid))]
'''
path.write_text(source)
# Run transform on demo and test inputs.
namespace={}
exec(compile(source, str(path), 'exec'), namespace)
transform=namespace['transform']
demo_colors=[0,0,9,8,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,2,0,0,5,0,0,0,0,0,3]

demo_out=transform(demo)
print('demo verified:', [row[0] for row in demo_out] == demo_expected_colors)
